beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Length tells how far this chalk reaches from one end to the other.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The ruler shows zero to three: three centimeters.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: C m means centimeters.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The other pieces have been measured too. These numbers record six chalk lengths. Numbers we collect are called data.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A number line has numbers in order with equal spaces. Each step here is one centimeter.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: A line plot shows measurements with marks above a number line. Each X stands for one measurement.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Place the first mark above three. The number below names its length.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Five centimeters. Place its mark above five.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Three is already there. I'll leave this one alone.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The first piece and this piece have equal lengths. Both measurements need a mark.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Same length, another piece. I need another mark above.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Stacking keeps both marks visible above the right number.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Two centimeters. One mark above two.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Five centimeters. Another mark above five.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Five again. This piece needs its own mark too.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: No piece measured four centimeters. Four keeps its place, with no mark above it.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: From three to four,

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: then four to five: each step is one centimeter.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One piece.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Then another. Two pieces measured three centimeters.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: These six measurements make this line plot.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Two centimeters: one mark.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Three centimeters: two marks.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Four centimeters: no marks.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Five centimeters: three marks.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Six measurements, six marks, including every repeated length.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: One measurement, one mark, right above its number.
